description: Synthetic documents for the Paytm Saathi hackathon demo. Not a real policy or claim decision.

clauses.title: Eligible inpatient expenses
clauses.text: For the synthetic demonstration only, eligible inpatient hospital expenses are considered subject to the limits and exclusions in this sample policy.

clauses.title: Room category limit
clauses.text: Room and nursing expenses are subject to the room category limit selected in the policy schedule. Excess room charges may affect related claim amounts.

clauses.title: Claim documents
clauses.text: A completed claim may require the itemized final bill, discharge summary, prescriptions, investigation reports, and payment receipts.
